exports.name: Breakpoint
exports.description:
Responsive keys: `base` (no media query) plus the application's breakpoint names — the defaults
`sm md lg xl 2xl`, or the names configured in neshel.config.ts once the declarations generated
by `neshel generate` are part of the program (ADR 0010).

exports.name: Caption
exports.description: Small supporting text (`p` by default; `figcaption` for figures). Muted by default.

props.name: align
props.description: Text alignment (logical: `start`/`end`).

props.name: family
props.description: Font role (Heading `"display"`, Paragraph and Caption `"body"`; Text inherits).

props.name: leading
props.description: Unitless line height; defaults to the size's leading. Drives Capsize trimming.

props.name: measure
props.description: Maximum line length: `narrow` 45ch, `comfortable` 65ch, `wide` 80ch.

props.name: size
props.description: Size token; `font-size = token × the font role's cap-height scale`.

props.name: tone
props.description: Colour role paired with the background for contrast (Caption defaults to `"muted"`).

props.name: tracking
props.description: Letter spacing.

props.name: trim
props.description: Capsize trimming of the space above the cap height and below the baseline (default true).

props.name: truncate
props.description: One line with an ellipsis (clips overflow, so trimming is removed).

props.name: weight
props.description: Font weight; Heading defaults to `"semibold"`.

props.name: wrap
props.description: Line wrapping strategy (`balance` suits headings, `pretty` paragraphs).
